items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: he and I -- he used to fool around on the guitar and I'd fool around on the piano

ctx.x: But different periods of history, where they would think it would be bad for getting jobs or something like that. Do you think --

Well, a lot of times that happened, you know, people didn't want to -- I know a fella that -- one of the first fellas when I was in school. His name was Dizzy Green, and Orville Green was his real name and his folks just looked like they were white, you know, and he looked white, see? But for some reason, they were colored, you know? And so he and I -- he used to fool around on the guitar and I'd fool around on the piano, you know what I mean, and so he left Muskogee and went to the coast, West Coast, because he…
busy right now. But come on by the house. I'm sure my mother or aunt will have some work for you to do. Come on by there any time."
